mapper.sql: SELECT v.voyage_number, v.adopted_info_version, v.source_kind, v.source_ref, v.acquired_at, v.published_at, v.version, p.call_no, p.port_unlocode, p.arrival_at, p.departure_at FROM routing.voyage v JOIN routing.port_call p ON p.voyage_number = v.voyage_number
mapper.select: WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM routing.port_call d WHERE d.voyage_number = v.voyage_number AND d.departure_at > #{departingAfter}) ORDER BY v.voyage_number, p.call_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO routing.voyage (voyage_number, adopted_info_version, source_kind, source_ref, acquired_at, published_at, version, updated_at) VALUES (#{voyageNumber}, #{adoptedInfoVersion}, #{sourceKind}, #{sourceRef}, #{acquiredAt}, #{publishedAt}, #{version}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO routing.port_call (voyage_number, call_no, port_unlocode, arrival_at, departure_at) VALUES (#{voyageNumber}, #{callNo}, #{portUnlocode}, #{arrivalAt}, #{departureAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, port_unlocode, min_connection_minutes, valid_from, valid_to FROM routing.connection_rule ORDER BY id
